name: Hotel Goverdhan Tourist Complex Restaurant
why_it_matters: On-site restaurant of Hotel Goverdhan Tourist Complex on the Agra Road approach — the most-reviewed Fatehpur Sikri sit-down option after a monument tour. Pure-veg (eggs available), homely service, reasonable prices.
insider_tip: Dine here before catching the afternoon Agra-bound bus — the next clean dining option is 30km back at Sikandra. Open daytime through dinner.
signature_address: Hotel Goverdhan Tourist Complex, Agra Road, Fatehpur Sikri 283110

name: Hotel Ajay Palace Rooftop Restaurant
why_it_matters: Family-run rooftop run by the Agarwal family — long marble table with sightlines to Jama Masjid and Buland Darwaza. Specialises in koftas (cheese, kashmiri-style with cashew and grape) and Fatehpur's signature nan khatai cookies.
insider_tip: Open 8am-9pm. Note the location: 30m east of the bus stand, NOT inside it — there's a separate 'Ajay Restaurant' inside the bus stand that locals warn against. Cold beer available with the rooftop view.
signature_address: Agra Road, near Bus Stand, Fatehpur Sikri 283110

name: Sher-e-Punjab Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Bypass-side dhaba serving Indian/Punjabi/Asian — one of the few non-veg sit-down options in town. Suits drivers and tour groups passing through on the Agra-Bharatpur axis.
insider_tip: If you're driving onwards to Bharatpur or Jaipur, this is a more practical lunch stop than the in-town Goverdhan option — closer to the bypass.
signature_address: Fatehpur Sikri Bypass Crossing, Fatehpur Sikri 283110
